summary: We've developed a website that compiles all our findings on the topic into an interactive map, where you can easily click a place on the map and read our proposals regarding it. Our main idea is that Ukraine, especially right now during the ongoing war and also in the future after it, is a place that is worth exploring and has experts worth consulting to gain unique knowledge and experience that would be of great use in both building and living in Martian and Lunar bases. It is important because such experience and knowledge are almost entirely unique to Ukraine, with many parts of the experience mimicking what could happen to people living outside of Earth.
details: This project is a website that shows places in Ukraine that we propose as Moon or Mars analogs. Those places are a result of our research using NASA data as well as data from other sources. The website contains an interactive map, where the user can click on one of the marked places on the map and see details about it as well as our explanations on why it was chosen as an analogue. One of the benefits of it is the fact that it allows for easy and convenient viewing of the results of our research. A map allows to get a better grasp of where the analogues are situated as well as makes it look more visually appealing than simple written text. Another benefit are the newfound analogue places and viewpoints. Our intention is to show that the Mars and Moon are closer than we think and that places analogous to them can be found at our homeland too. We mainly used HTML, CSS and JavaScript to develop he website. Microsoft Office Word was used for note taking and gathering data before it was put on the website. Website was make using Visual Studio Code as the IDE, as well as GitHub for version controll and cooperative work between team members. Canva was used to design the presentation.
